curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary English
curriculum.note: Objective codes and wording are taken verbatim from the Stage 2 pages of the Cambridge Primary English 0844 Curriculum Framework, which is in the Primary 1 English folder on Google Drive and covers all six stages. The Stage 2 folder holds no scheme of work, so the units follow the genres the framework recommends for Stage 2: real-life stories, traditional tales from different cultures, longer stories by one author, poetry, instructions, non-chronological reports, explanations and dictionaries.

objectives.title: Learn the different ways in which vowels can be pronounced, e.g. how, low, apple, apron
Use phonics as the main method of tackling unfamiliar words
Identify syllables and split familiar compound words into parts

Begin to develop likes and dislikes in reading and listening to stories drawing on background information and vocabulary provided
Read aloud with increased accuracy, fluency and expression
Begin to read with fluency and expression, taking some notice of punctuation, including speech marks
Explore a variety of non-fiction texts on screen
Locate words by initial letter in simple dictionaries, glossaries and indexes
Discuss the meaning of unfamiliar words encountered in reading

objectives.title: Predict story endings

plan.intro: Hold up a book. Ask what we can tell about it before we open it.
